title: Construct workflow template
description: Shape validator for YAML workflow templates in templates/workflows/. A workflow template declares the artifact chain, input variables, and beads task items that are scaffolded together in one command.

id.description: Lowercase identifier used in the CLI and file lookups.

version.description: Schema version. Increment when the template shape changes in a breaking way.

inputs.description: Variable declarations. Values are substituted into all ${variable_name} placeholders in string fields.

prompt.description: Human-readable prompt shown when the CLI collects this input interactively.

artifacts.description: Ordered list of document artifacts to scaffold. Each artifact references a doc template by filename and specifies the output path.

template.description: Filename of a template in templates/docs/ (e.g. prd.md). If not found, a stub markdown file is created instead.

path.description: Output path relative to the project root. May contain ${variable_name} placeholders.

title.description: Document title written into the artifact frontmatter. May contain ${variable_name} placeholders.

depends_on.description: Paths of artifacts that must exist before this one is created. Used for ordering and dependency checks.

beads_items.description: Beads task items to create alongside the artifacts. The CLI creates these; the instantiation engine only returns what would be created.

type.description: Beads item type (e.g. feature, task, chore, bug).

title.description: Beads item title. May contain ${variable_name} placeholders.

link_to.description: Path of the artifact this item is linked to. May contain ${variable_name} placeholders.

depends_on_prior.description: When true, this item should only start after the previous beads_items entry is complete.

checks.description: Lightweight correctness checks run after instantiation. Each check names a kind and the file targets to evaluate.

kind.description: Check kind. 'file-order' verifies the listed files exist in the declared sequence.
